patches.reason: Hardhat 3.22 and its plugins require Zod 3. Backport early rejection of oversized constrained arrays/exact lengths/sets in TS, ESM and CJS without a breaking validator migration. Zod 3 has no sized Map API. Application code uses 4.6.7.
patches.auditHandling: pnpm audit:verified verifies the patch checksum and live parser behavior before excluding this exact version-only finding. All other advisories fail normally.
